name: Minase Sakurako
source:
Sakurako is soft-spoken and has a gentle personality, but is also a natural airhead. She is considered to be one of the two school “idols” due to her beauty, she’s very good friends with [url=/c808]Mayuri[/url] and is in a year above [url=/c804]Shou[/url]. Sakurako is very kind and innocent to everyone. Loves to try new things because it’s exciting, and has a very creative mind.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flyable_Heart]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/24/flyable-heart-review/]Liemyx's review[/url]]
